references.text: The magicians in Egypt tried to do the same with their secret arts, but could not surpass Moses and Aaron.
Egypt's magicians did the same with their secret arts, showing their limited power compared to God's power.
The magicians could not produce gnats and acknowledged that this was the finger of God, an earlier admission of their limitation.
Boils in Egypt are mentioned as one of the curses the Lord will bring upon those who do not obey His commands.
The Lord warns of painful boils on the knees and thighs, from the sole of the foot to the crown of the head, as a judgment against disobedience.
Job was struck with painful boils from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head, a similar physical affliction that also struck the Egyptians.
In Revelation, painful boils strike people as one of the final plagues, recalling the plagues of Egypt.
